name.en: A Journey to the North Xinjiang

desc.zh: 2024 年 2 月，我踏上了前往北疆的旅途。这是一片我从来没有触及过的陌生土地，甚至可以算是有些难以想象。寒冬的气息笼罩着每一座山峰，草原经历秋风变得萧瑟广阔。旅途的路线从乌鲁木齐到伊犁，再到阿勒泰，我见到了天山的冰封山谷，在赛里木湖经历了一次难忘的奇遇，也领略了喀纳斯的冰雪仙境。北疆的每一寸土地都在我的意料之外，对于一个从来没怎么见过雪的南方人来说，让我完全实现了从今往后的“冰雪自由”
desc.en: In February 2024, I embarked on a journey to northern Xinjiang, a land I had never set foot on before. The chill of winter enveloped every mountain peak, and there are grasslands weathered by autumn winds, stretched out vast and desolate. I witnessed the icy valleys of the Tianshan Mountains and marveled at the snowy wonderland of Kanas. An unforgettable encounter at Sayram Lake makes the journey even more unique. Every inch of northern Xinjiang surpassed my expectations, and for someone from the south who had rarely seen snow, this journey finally fulfilled my dream of experiencing “snow freedom”—no longer needing to envy places with heavy snowfall, as my entire being had already been cleansed by the sacred ice and snow of northern Xinjiang.
